notes: Source publishes separate Last Name and First Name columns. The normalized name joins those exact fields, in that order, with one space and no invented comma.

Source chosen remuneration explicitly includes taxable benefits; it is separate from expenses. The schedule heading refers to remuneration and expenses exceeding $75,000, and each imported remuneration independently exceeds $75,000.
Dashes are unknown/null, not numeric zero. Employee schedule only; board and supplier schedules and below-threshold aggregates excluded.

Reporting dates come from the original cover and employee schedule, never the filename. Current FIA_2026.pdf contains2024/25; FIA_2025.pdf contains2025/26, consistent internally despite the filenames.
Some source names lack a verified surname/given-name separator; matches across years may be incomplete.
